supporting.title: A glass of water with each meal
Name one good thing before bed

days.title: Do slow breathing for {minutes} minutes while sitting comfortably
days.reason: Slow breathing is calming and gentle on your body.

days.title: Wind down for {minutes} minutes before bed
days.reason: A calm evening can help you sleep better.

days.title: Spend {minutes} minutes planning a simple, healthy meal
days.reason: Planning ahead makes good choices easier.

days.title: Sit by a window or outside for {minutes} minutes of daylight
days.reason: Daylight can lift your mood and help your sleep.

days.title: Call or message someone you trust for {minutes} minutes
days.reason: Connecting with people is good for your health.

days.title: Write down the questions for your next doctor or nurse visit for {minutes} minutes
days.reason: Being ready helps you get the most from your visit.

days.title: Spend {minutes} minutes doing something calm that you enjoy
days.reason: Calm, happy moments are part of living well.
